changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO org_units (code, tenant_id, name, short_name, type, parent_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT d.code, d.tenant_id, d.name, d.short_name, 'Department', parent_ou.id, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM departments d LEFT JOIN colleges c ON c.id = d.college_id LEFT JOIN org_units parent_ou ON parent_ou.code = c.code;

changeSet.author: daniel.onyeachonam
daniel.onyeachonam
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO schedulable_unit_codes (code, tenant_id, unit_code, schedulable_unit_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT cc.code, cc.tenant_id, cc.course_code, su.id, cc.created_at, cc.updated_at FROM course_codes cc JOIN courses co ON co.id = cc.course_id JOIN schedulable_units su ON su.code = co.code;

changeSet.author: daniel.onyeachonam
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO schedulable_unit_participants (code, tenant_id, level_id, schedulable_unit_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT cp.code, cp.tenant_id, cp.level_id, su.id, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at FROM course_participants cp JOIN courses co ON co.id = cp.course_id JOIN schedulable_units su ON su.code = co.code;

changeSet.author: daniel.onyeachonam
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO schedulable_unit_participant_org_units (participant_id, org_unit_id) SELECT sup.id, ou.id FROM course_participant_departments cpd JOIN course_participants cp ON cp.id = cpd.course_participant_id JOIN schedulable_unit_participants sup ON sup.code = cp.code JOIN departments d ON d.id = cpd.department_id JOIN org_units ou ON ou.code = d.code;

changeSet.author: daniel.onyeachonam
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE classrooms SET org_unit_id = ou.id FROM colleges c JOIN org_units ou ON ou.code = c.code WHERE classrooms.college_id = c.id;
UPDATE users SET org_unit_id = ou.id FROM departments d JOIN org_units ou ON ou.code = d.code WHERE users.department_id = d.id;

changeSet.author: daniel.onyeachonam
changeSet.sql: UPDATE schedules SET schedulable_unit_id = su.id FROM courses co JOIN schedulable_units su ON su.code = co.code WHERE schedules.course_id = co.id;
